title: Original Pronunciation - Hamlet | To Be, or not to be... | Ben Crystal
summary: Ben Crystal performs Hamlet's 'To be, or not to be' in Original Pronunciation, the reconstructed accent of Shakespeare's time, on a London balcony.
why: HN uses it as the example of how different Shakespeare sounded in original pronunciation.

quote.text: If you listen to a performance of Shakespeare that replicates the original pronunciation, it's wildly different.
